comparisons.peer_topic: Definition and Scope of Other Secured Financings
comparisons.peer_summary: Other secured financings include liabilities from collateralized notes, asset transfers accounted for as financings, and consolidated VIEs where the firm is the primary beneficiary, with maturities originally exceeding one year.
comparisons.comparison: Goldman Sachs (GS) discloses specific balances for nonrecourse other secured financings, whereas Morgan Stanley (MS) provides the definition and scope of other secured financings but does not report a specific nonrecourse balance in the provided text. MS confirms that its other secured financings include collateralized notes and asset transfers accounted for as financings, which is the structural category under which GS reports its nonrecourse arrangements. MS notes these liabilities are generally payable from trading assets, while GS quantifies the nonrecourse portion of this category.

sentences.text: Other secured financings included nonrecourse arrangements.
Nonrecourse other secured financings were $3.74 billion as of December 2024 and $5.57 billion as of December 2023.

Other secured financings include the liabilities related to collateralized notes, transfers of financial assets that are accounted for as financings rather than sales and consolidated VIEs where the Firm is deemed to be the primary beneficiary.
See Note 15 for further information on other secured financings related to VIEs and securitization activities.
